mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals monetary easing, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite unemployment rate rise, or correlation between UNRATE change and SPX returns is negative but insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in the prior month indicates weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative SPX returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate exceeding 0.5% (CPIAUCSL change) signals high inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%), or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 6 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in payroll growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns is not negative and significant (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary conditions (GDPC1 annual growth rate < 0.0%), the Federal Reserve's aggressive monetary easing policy drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy recovers.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of recessionary periods (GDPC1 annual growth rate < 0.0%), or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points and fall in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the prior 3 months indicates a policy response to economic weakness, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.2pp in 3 months
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor market deterioration
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising UNRATE and falling FEDFUNDS does not lead to negative SPX returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
